intro_html: Tikka masala at home for about $4.06 a bowl (at everyday cost) is a genuine win. This creamy, spiced tomato chicken is high protein, freezes beautifully, and tastes like takeout without the takeout price. One batch makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $4.06 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings runs about 56g protein for roughly 554 calories, at around $2.24 a bowl.
upsell_html: Takeout flavor at meal-prep prices is exactly the kind of upgrade your week needs. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Coconut milk gives you that rich, creamy sauce for a fraction of what heavy cream costs.
Grab the value pack chicken breast to keep every bowl cheap.
If you have garam masala or curry powder in the cabinet, lean on your existing spices instead of buying a special blend.
make_it: Add the chicken breast to the crock with both cans of diced tomatoes.
Pour in both cans of coconut milk.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back through the creamy sauce.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Serve over rice with broccoli on the side.
